title: Crataegus monogyna tea for medicinal use
intro: Crataegus monogyna tea is a herbal preparation made from the leaves and flowers of the hawthorn tree, known for its calming and cardiovascular benefits. It is commonly used in herbalism to support heart health, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The tea is often recommended for individuals experiencing mild anxiety, insomnia, or high blood pressure. Its mild flavor and soothing properties make it a popular choice in traditional medicine. Regular consumption may help improve circulation and ease symptoms of nervous exhaustion.
